category.name: Spreadsheet databases
category.description: Relational business data with spreadsheet editing, forms and configurable views.
category.audience: Operations, marketing, sales, HR, finance and project teams building shared business trackers and lightweight internal apps.
category.audienceRationale: Cross-functional business records and workflows apply across many industries; requires structured-data collaboration rather than every employee role.

pricing.note: Team starts at $20/user/month billed annually; free plan available; price checked October 21, 2026.

oss.name: Grist Community
locked: MCP server and current AI Assistant
Advanced administration, audit streaming and multiple team sites
oss.classificationReason: Apache-2.0 community core. Current self-hosted pricing reserves both everyday automation/notifications and governance capabilities for commercial activation; qualifying smaller organizations may request a free activation key, which does not make those features OSS.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis available; overall 5.8/10; activity 6.3/10. Directional heuristic, not security audit.

oss.name: Baserow Open Source Edition
locked: Kanban, calendar, timeline and survey views
JSON, XML and Excel table export
Granular permissions, SSO and audit logging
oss.classificationReason: OSE code MIT; root license explicitly excludes premium/enterprise directories under separate licenses, and docs use CC-BY-SA-4.0. Everyday views, comments and export formats require paid plans, including self-hosted.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis available; overall 6.5/10; activity 6.4/10. Directional heuristic, not security audit.

oss.name: Teable Community
locked: Advanced AI features in commercial edition
Paid self-hosted features require activation key; full current CE comparison not verified
oss.classificationReason: Root declares AGPL-3.0 core apps plus MIT utility packages, then adds a blanket prohibition on modifying, replacing or removing brand assets. Conservatively withheld from verified OSI recommendations because this is not unmodified AGPL; permissibility of those additional terms needs specialist review. Independently, commercial AI is absent from Community.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis available; overall 4.9/10; activity 4.9/10. Directional heuristic, not security audit.

oss.name: NocoDB Community
locked: Community limited to 2 workflows per base and 2 interfaces per workspace
Unlimited interfaces/workflows, scripts and dashboards require Business
oss.classificationReason: Pinned root license updated January 29, 2026 puts master/develop under Sustainable Use License: internal-business/noncommercial use and noncommercial free distribution restrictions. Source-available, not OSI OSS; cannot recommend as an OSS alternative despite free self-hosting.

health.rsx: Central authenticated rsx analysis available; overall 5.8/10; activity 7.4/10. Directional heuristic, not security audit.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Relational spreadsheets and Python formulas suit business trackers. Plan formula, interface and automation rebuilding; commercial self-hosted features remain gated.

Official importer transfers tables, records, relationships, attachments and grid views. Automations, interfaces, integrations and permissions need rebuilding; comments and revision history do not transfer. Free edition lacks several workflow views and export formats.

exclusions.name: NocoDB (current releases)
exclusions.reason: Source-available Sustainable Use License, not OSI OSS; retained candidate metadata for transparency, excluded from OSS recommendations.

exclusions.name: Teable (verified OSI shortlist)
exclusions.reason: Custom brand restrictions in root license warrant review; do not advertise as unmodified AGPL. Commercial AI features also gated.
